'''Oeana Tching''', known as the '''Invisible Empress''', was the leader of the [[Atrisian Empire]] five hundred&ndash;fifty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. She was known to be a highly successful leader, and she mastered [[Uueg Tching]]'s ''[[Sayings]]''.
